name: AIFit
niche: home fitness, short science-backed workouts, habit building
audience: busy adults 25-45 who want to get fit at home in 20-30 minutes a day
voice: direct, warm, evidence-based, zero fluff, a little playful. Second person. Short sentences.
cta_default: Follow for a new 20-minute workout every week.
visual_style: clean, bright, modern home gym and outdoor morning light; photoreal; diverse real-looking people; no text baked into the image; vertical 9:16 composition with subject centred and headroom for captions
negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry, low quality
